svg.title: What the names on an award can hide
svg.desc: A problem: A difficult observation needs complementary skills.. Different jobs: A student, technician or senior scientist may enable a result.. Public credit: Naming only leaders can obscure this division of labour.

g.text: What the names on an award can hide
A difficult observation needs complementary skills.
A student, technician or senior scientist may enable a result.
Naming only leaders can obscure this division of labour.
